title: Aynaghar inside DGFI headquarters, has 22 cells: Inquiry commission
note: Report on Bangladesh's enforced-disappearance inquiry commission identifying a detention site inside DGFI headquarters and describing complaints against security agencies.
whyItMatters: It contextualizes the post-2024 enforced-disappearance inquiry, Aynaghar allegations, and complaints involving RAB, DGFI, DB, and CTTC.
